title: Jiron Form Builder export file, format jfb-form-export/1
description: A form as Jiron Form Builder exports it, with the library option lists its definition names (ADR-0002, ADR-0046). An import also refuses what this schema cannot say: a definition whose key is not the form's, two option lists with one key, a file larger than four times the site's definition limit, and everything a save refuses in the definition. A definition of an older schema version is upgraded when it is read.

format.description: The format; a newer one is refused with unsupported_format.

packageVersion.description: The version of Jiron Form Builder that wrote the file.

exportedUtc.description: When the file was written, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

form.description: The form where it was exported. An import takes its name and alias unless it is given others, and always gives the new form new keys.

optionLists.description: The library option lists the definition names by key that the exporting site had.

Key.description: A GUID in lowercase, not the empty one.

kind.description: Where the options come from, such as Manual.

config.description: The source's configuration, which its kind checks.

items.description: The items of a manual or uploaded list.
